package kubernetes.admission.k8s_serviceaccount.k8s_serviceaccount_sa_deny_impersonation_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ServiceAccount User Impersonation Without Granular RBAC Verbs (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-serviceaccount-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-serviceaccount"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_serviceaccount.k8s_serviceaccount_sa_disable_default_token_automount_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable automountServiceAccountToken on Default Namespace ServiceAccounts (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ServiceAccount"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.automountServiceAccountToken
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define automountServiceAccountToken according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: "k8s-serviceaccount-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-serviceaccount"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_serviceaccount.k8s_serviceaccount_sa_projected_bound_tokens_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Short-Lived Bound ServiceAccount Token Volume Projection (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Pod"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.volumes[_].projected.sources[_].serviceAccountToken according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}

  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-serviceaccount"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"

  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true

          type: RuntimeDefault

        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:

              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for ServiceAccount within Hardened Pod Sandbox & Rootless Capability Drop Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[ServiceAccounts & Token Projection] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_serviceaccount.k8s_serviceaccount_sa_deny_impersonation_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ServiceAccount User Impersonation Without Granular RBAC Verbs (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-serviceaccount-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-serviceaccount"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_serviceaccount.k8s_serviceaccount_sa_disable_default_token_automount_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable automountServiceAccountToken on Default Namespace ServiceAccounts (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ServiceAccount"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.automountServiceAccountToken
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define automountServiceAccountToken according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: "k8s-serviceaccount-hardened-15"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-serviceaccount"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-15"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-15)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
remediation: Inspect manifest or apply Gatekeeper/Kyverno policy: kubectl apply -f k8s-role-hardened.yaml --dry-run=server

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Hardened Pod Sandbox & Rootless Capability Drop Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

    group request(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Admission Request Pipeline]
    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]
    group target(logos:k8s-pod)[Approved Workload Namespace]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request

    service mut(logos:k8s-webhook)[Mutating Injection Hook] in gate
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-2 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-2 • Profile E)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.

    group ingress(logos:k8s-service)[Headless Service Routing]
    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-3 • Profile G)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Monitored Container Sandbox]
    group detector(logos:k8s-falco)[eBPF Probe & Syscall Sensor]

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-3 • Profile H)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Multi-Tenant Namespace Boundary & Resource Quota Sandbox. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Ingress Perimeter & Microsegmented Pod Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.

    group edge(logos:k8s-ingress)[Ingress & Edge TLS Boundary]

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-4 • Profile K)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-4 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. architecture-beta
    group request(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Admission Request Pipeline]
    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]
    group target(logos:k8s-pod)[Approved Workload Namespace]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request
    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[Pod Security Standards] in request

    service val(logos:k8s-webhook)[ValidatingWebhook Fail-Closed] in gate
    service mut(logos:k8s-webhook)[Mutating Injection Hook] in gate
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    api:R --> L:psa
    psa:B --> T:val
    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    pdb:B --> T:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-5 • Profile M)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
manifest:

    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
remediation: Inspect manifest or apply Gatekeeper/Kyverno policy: kubectl apply -f k8s-role-hardened.yaml --dry-run=server

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-5 • Profile N)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Resilient StatefulSet & Persistent Volume Encryption Tier. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.

    group ingress(logos:k8s-service)[Headless Service Routing]
    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted Volume Enclave]

    service svc(logos:k8s-service)[Headless ClusterIP] in ingress

    workload:R --> L:pdb

    pvc:R --> L:sec
    sec:R --> L:mon

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-5 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-5 • Profile O)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

architecture-beta
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Monitored Container Sandbox]
    group detector(logos:k8s-falco)[eBPF Probe & Syscall Sensor]
    group siem(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Audit Logging & SOAR Playbook]

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in pod

    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Falco Kernel Engine] in detector
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium Network Flow] in detector

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube Audit Sink] in siem
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Automated Pod Quarantine] in siem

    workload:R --> L:secprof
    workload:B --> T:falco
    secprof:B --> T:ebpf
    falco:R --> L:api
    ebpf:R --> L:webhook

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-6 • Profile P)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Multi-Tenant Namespace Boundary & Resource Quota Sandbox. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group tenant(logos:k8s-psa)[Namespace Hardened Perimeter]
    group compute(logos:k8s-quota)[Quota Enforcement & Schedulers]
    group workload(logos:k8s-pod)[Isolated Application Runtime]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Baseline] in tenant
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Namespace Isolation NetPol] in tenant

    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota CPU/RAM] in compute
    service limit(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Defaults] in compute

    service app(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in workload
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Restricted ServiceAccount] in workload
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[High-Availability PDB] in workload

    psa:R --> L:netpol
    netpol:B --> T:quota
    quota:R --> L:limit
    limit:B --> T:app
    app:R --> L:sa
    app:B --> T:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-6 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-6 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-7 • Profile S)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-7 • Profile S)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-7 • Profile T)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group request(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Admission Request Pipeline]
    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]
    group target(logos:k8s-pod)[Approved Workload Namespace]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request
    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[Pod Security Standards] in request

    service val(logos:k8s-webhook)[ValidatingWebhook Fail-Closed] in gate
    service mut(logos:k8s-webhook)[Mutating Injection Hook] in gate
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    api:R --> L:psa
    psa:B --> T:val
    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    pdb:B --> T:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-7 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-7 • Profile U)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:

    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:

  template:

      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

              memory: "512Mi"

              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-9 • Profile A)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-10 • Profile B)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group request(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Admission Request Pipeline]
    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]
    group target(logos:k8s-pod)[Approved Workload Namespace]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request
    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[Pod Security Standards] in request

    service val(logos:k8s-webhook)[ValidatingWebhook Fail-Closed] in gate
    service mut(logos:k8s-webhook)[Mutating Injection Hook] in gate
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    api:R --> L:psa
    psa:B --> T:val
    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    pdb:B --> T:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_wildcards_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-10 • Profile C)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_no_escalate_bind_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit verbs ["bind", "escalate"] on Roles to Prevent RBAC Privilege Escalation (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRole"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].verbs according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Resilient StatefulSet & Persistent Volume Encryption Tier. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:k8s-service)[Headless Service Routing]
    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted Volume Enclave]

    service svc(logos:k8s-service)[Headless ClusterIP] in ingress
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Pod-to-Pod Mutual TLS] in ingress

    service workload(logos:k8s-role)[Roles & ClusterRoles Least-Privilege] in cluster
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[MinAvailable Quorum] in cluster
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Zero-Token SA] in cluster

    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted PV Storage] in storage
    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[CSI Ephemeral Volume] in storage
    service mon(logos:k8s-falco)[Storage Integrity Check] in storage

    netpol:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    sa:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:sec
    sec:R --> L:mon

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_role.k8s_role_role_restrict_secrets_access_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict verbs ["get", "list", "watch"] on core Secrets API to Authorized Roles (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Role"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.rules[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define rules[_].resources according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: "k8s-role-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-role"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit Wildcard Verbs ("*") and Wildcard Resources in Roles and ClusterRoles (Tier-11 • Profile E)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Role within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
