opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-10 • Profile C)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-10 • Profile D)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Resilient StatefulSet & Persistent Volume Encryption Tier. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:k8s-service)[Headless Service Routing]
    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted Volume Enclave]

    service svc(logos:k8s-service)[Headless ClusterIP] in ingress
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Pod-to-Pod Mutual TLS] in ingress

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in cluster
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[MinAvailable Quorum] in cluster
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Zero-Token SA] in cluster

    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted PV Storage] in storage
    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[CSI Ephemeral Volume] in storage
    service mon(logos:k8s-falco)[Storage Integrity Check] in storage

    svc:R --> L:netpol
    netpol:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    sa:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:sec
    sec:R --> L:mon

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-11 • Profile E)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

architecture-beta
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Monitored Container Sandbox]
    group detector(logos:k8s-falco)[eBPF Probe & Syscall Sensor]
    group siem(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Audit Logging & SOAR Playbook]

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in pod
    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[Restricted Seccomp Profile] in pod

    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Falco Kernel Engine] in detector
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium Network Flow] in detector

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube Audit Sink] in siem
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Automated Pod Quarantine] in siem

    workload:R --> L:secprof
    workload:B --> T:falco
    secprof:B --> T:ebpf
    falco:R --> L:api
    ebpf:R --> L:webhook

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-11"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-11"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-11)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-11 • Profile F)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Multi-Tenant Namespace Boundary & Resource Quota Sandbox. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group tenant(logos:k8s-psa)[Namespace Hardened Perimeter]
    group compute(logos:k8s-quota)[Quota Enforcement & Schedulers]
    group workload(logos:k8s-pod)[Isolated Application Runtime]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Baseline] in tenant
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Namespace Isolation NetPol] in tenant

    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota CPU/RAM] in compute
    service limit(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Defaults] in compute

    service app(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in workload
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Restricted ServiceAccount] in workload
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[High-Availability PDB] in workload

    psa:R --> L:netpol
    netpol:B --> T:quota
    quota:R --> L:limit
    limit:B --> T:app
    app:R --> L:sa
    app:B --> T:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-11"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-11"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-11)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-11"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-11"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-11)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-12 • Profile H)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Hardened Pod Sandbox & Rootless Capability Drop Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-12"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-12)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-12 • Profile I)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-12"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-12)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-12 • Profile J)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

architecture-beta
    group request(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Admission Request Pipeline]
    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]
    group target(logos:k8s-pod)[Approved Workload Namespace]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request
    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[Pod Security Standards] in request

    service val(logos:k8s-webhook)[ValidatingWebhook Fail-Closed] in gate
    service mut(logos:k8s-webhook)[Mutating Injection Hook] in gate
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    pdb:B --> T:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-12"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-12)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-13 • Profile K)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-13 • Profile L)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Resilient StatefulSet & Persistent Volume Encryption Tier. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:k8s-service)[Headless Service Routing]
    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted Volume Enclave]

    service svc(logos:k8s-service)[Headless ClusterIP] in ingress
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Pod-to-Pod Mutual TLS] in ingress

    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in cluster
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[MinAvailable Quorum] in cluster
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Zero-Token SA] in cluster

    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted PV Storage] in storage
    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[CSI Ephemeral Volume] in storage
    service mon(logos:k8s-falco)[Storage Integrity Check] in storage

    svc:R --> L:netpol
    netpol:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    sa:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:sec

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-14 • Profile O)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for RoleBinding within Ingress Perimeter & Microsegmented Pod Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.

    group edge(logos:k8s-ingress)[Ingress & Edge TLS Boundary]
    group podtier(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Isolation & SecurityContext Enclave]

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_prefer_role_binding_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Namespace-Scoped RoleBindings Instead of Global ClusterRoleBindings (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.roleRef
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define roleRef.kind according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-binding)[RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_audit_subjects_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Audit Subject Kinds and Prohibit Anonymous or Insecure Subject Mappings (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "RoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].kind according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_binding.k8s_binding_binding_no_cluster_admin_all_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit ClusterRoleBindings Granting cluster-admin to system:authenticated (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.subjects[_]
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define subjects[_].name according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: "k8s-binding-hardened-15"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-binding"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-15"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-15)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Ingress Perimeter & Microsegmented Pod Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_default_deny_all_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.policyTypes according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

  template:
    spec:

        runAsNonRoot: true

        seccompProfile:

              cpu: "500m"

title: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Hardened Pod Sandbox & Rootless Capability Drop Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[NetworkPolicies & Microsegmentation] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_explicit_ingress_selectors_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.ingress[_].from[_].podSelector according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[NetworkPolicies & Microsegmentation] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_restricted_egress_dns_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.egress[_].to[_].ipBlock according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-2 • Profile D)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate.     service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    val:R --> L:mut

    quota:B --> T:workload

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_default_deny_all_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-2 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.policyTypes according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules (Tier-2 • Profile E)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[NetworkPolicies & Microsegmentation] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_explicit_ingress_selectors_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.ingress[_].from[_].podSelector according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_restricted_egress_dns_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.egress[_].to[_].ipBlock according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-3 • Profile G)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

    workload:R --> L:secprof

    secprof:B --> T:ebpf
    falco:R --> L:api

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_default_deny_all_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.policyTypes according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules (Tier-3 • Profile H)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Multi-Tenant Namespace Boundary & Resource Quota Sandbox. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

    group compute(logos:k8s-quota)[Quota Enforcement & Schedulers]
    group workload(logos:k8s-pod)[Isolated Application Runtime]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Baseline] in tenant

    service limit(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Defaults] in compute

    service app(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[NetworkPolicies & Microsegmentation] in workload

    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[High-Availability PDB] in workload

    psa:R --> L:netpol
    netpol:B --> T:quota
    quota:R --> L:limit
    limit:B --> T:app
    app:R --> L:sa
    app:B --> T:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_explicit_ingress_selectors_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.ingress[_].from[_].podSelector according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_restricted_egress_dns_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.egress[_].to[_].ipBlock according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_default_deny_all_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.policyTypes according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.ingress[_].from[_].podSelector according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Admission Controller & Webhook Governance Gate. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

architecture-beta

    group gate(logos:k8s-webhook)[OPA Gatekeeper & Webhook Gate]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[AdmissionReview API] in request

    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[LimitRange Verification] in gate

    service workload(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[NetworkPolicies & Microsegmentation] in target
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[Availability Quorum] in target
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Audit Sensor] in target

    val:R --> L:mut
    mut:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:pdb
    pdb:B --> T:falco

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_restricted_egress_dns_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.egress[_].to[_].ipBlock according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"

  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true

        - name: app

              memory: "512Mi"

              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_default_deny_all_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Default Deny All Ingress and Egress Policy on Every Namespace (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.policyTypes according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_explicit_ingress_selectors_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Explicit Namespace and Pod Selectors on Ingress Whitelist Rules (Tier-5 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.ingress[_].from[_].podSelector according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs (Tier-5 • Profile O)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for NetworkPolicy within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

    workload:R --> L:secprof
    workload:B --> T:falco
    secprof:B --> T:ebpf
    falco:R --> L:api
    ebpf:R --> L:webhook

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_networkpolicy.k8s_networkpolicy_netpol_restricted_egress_dns_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Egress Traffic to DNS CoreDNS Ports (UDP/TCP 53) and Permitted CIDRs (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "NetworkPolicy"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.egress[_].to[_].ipBlock according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: "k8s-networkpolicy-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-networkpolicy"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
