opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-4 • Profile K)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-4 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"

# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-5"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-5"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-5)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

    group cluster(logos:k8s-statefulset)[Ordered Stateful Enclave]

    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in cluster

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Zero-Token SA] in cluster

    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[Encrypted PV Storage] in storage

    workload:R --> L:pdb

    pvc:R --> L:sec

  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
remediation: Inspect manifest or apply Gatekeeper/Kyverno policy: kubectl apply -f k8s-pdb-hardened.yaml --dry-run=server

title: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-6 • Profile R)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Hardened Pod Sandbox & Rootless Capability Drop Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 5.2.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-6"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-6"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-6)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-7 • Profile S)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-7 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-7"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-7"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-7)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"

title: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-8 • Profile W)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Runtime Threat Detection & Falco Event Streaming. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Monitored Container Sandbox]

    workload:R --> L:secprof

    secprof:B --> T:ebpf
    falco:R --> L:api

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
manifest:

    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:

        runAsNonRoot: true

        seccompProfile:

            capabilities:

          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Multi-Tenant Namespace Boundary & Resource Quota Sandbox. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 1.2.1.

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-8"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-8"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-8)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:

      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true

        seccompProfile:

            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"

title: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-9 • Profile A)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-9"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-9"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-9)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-10 • Profile C)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Workload Identity & Projected Secret Store CSI Enclave. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.

architecture-beta
    group idp(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Identity & Projected Tokens]
    group pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Pod Runtime Isolation Enclave]
    group vault(logos:k8s-secret)[External KMS & Sealed Store]

    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Short-Lived Bound Token] in idp
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Namespace-Scoped Role] in idp
    service rb(logos:k8s-binding)[Subject RoleBinding] in idp

    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in pod
    service csi(logos:k8s-secret)[Secrets Store CSI Driver] in pod
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Read-Only ConfigMap] in pod

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[Cloud KMS Envelope] in vault
    service audit(logos:k8s-falco)[Access Audit Trail] in vault

    sa:R --> L:role
    role:R --> L:rb
    rb:B --> T:workload
    workload:R --> L:csi
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    csi:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:audit

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-10"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-10"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-10)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-11"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-11"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-11)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-11"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-11"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-11)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"

  template:

              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-12"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "performance-efficiency"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-12)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-12"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-12"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-12)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

            limits:
              cpu: "500m"

              cpu: "100m"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-13"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-13"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "cost-optimization"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-13)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_max_unavailable_restricted_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Prohibit maxUnavailable = 100% on Production PDBs to Guarantee Quorum (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.maxUnavailable according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:

  namespace: production

    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
remediation: Inspect manifest or apply Gatekeeper/Kyverno policy: kubectl apply -f k8s-pdb-hardened.yaml --dry-run=server

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_selector_match_labels_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify PDB MatchLabels Selector Corresponds to Valid Deployment Pod Labels (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.selector.matchLabels according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-14"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-14"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-14)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for PodDisruptionBudget within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.

architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudgets & Resiliency] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage

    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_pdb.k8s_pdb_pdb_min_available_enforced_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable >= 1 for Critical Services (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "PodDisruptionBudget"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.spec
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define spec.minAvailable according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: "k8s-pdb-hardened-15"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-pdb"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-15"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-15)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_readonly_port_disabled_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Kubelet Read-Only Port 10255 Across All Node Configurations (CIS 4.2.4)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.readOnlyPort according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

architecture-beta
    group admission(logos:k8s-webhook)[Admission Controller Gatekeeper]
    group sandbox(logos:k8s-pod)[Restricted Pod Sandbox Boundary]
    group kernel(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Seccomp & eBPF Kernel Enclave]

    service psa(logos:k8s-psa)[PSA Restricted Mode] in admission
    service webhook(logos:k8s-webhook)[Validating Admission Webhook] in admission
    service quota(logos:k8s-quota)[ResourceQuota & Limits] in admission

    service pod(logos:k8s-pod)[Rootless Pod Sandbox] in sandbox
    service workload(logos:k8s-node)[Kubelet & Node Host Security (CIS Benchmark)] in sandbox
    service cfg(logos:k8s-configmap)[Immutable ConfigMap] in sandbox

    service secprof(logos:k8s-node)[RuntimeDefault Seccomp] in kernel
    service ebpf(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium eBPF Enforcer] in kernel
    service falco(logos:k8s-falco)[Runtime Drift Alert] in kernel

    psa:R --> L:webhook
    webhook:B --> T:quota
    quota:B --> T:pod
    pod:R --> L:workload
    cfg:B --> T:workload
    workload:B --> T:secprof
    secprof:R --> L:ebpf
    ebpf:R --> L:falco

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_anonymous_auth_disabled_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubelet Anonymous Authentication Disabled (authentication.anonymous.enabled = false)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.authentication.anonymous.enabled according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Kubelet Webhook Authorization (authorization.mode = Webhook)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Node within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-node)[Kubelet & Node Host Security (CIS Benchmark)] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_authorization_webhook_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubelet Webhook Authorization (authorization.mode = Webhook)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.authorization.mode according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-1"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-1"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "operational-excellence"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-1)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kernel_sysctl_hardening_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kernel Sysctl Hardening and Protected Symlinks on Kubernetes Worker Nodes
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.sysctl
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define sysctl.fs.protected_symlinks according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}

package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_readonly_port_disabled_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Kubelet Read-Only Port 10255 Across All Node Configurations (CIS 4.2.4) (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.readOnlyPort according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}

apiVersion: apps/v1

    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001

        - name: app

            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_anonymous_auth_disabled_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubelet Anonymous Authentication Disabled (authentication.anonymous.enabled = false) (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.authentication.anonymous.enabled according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-2"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-2"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-2)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_readonly_port_disabled_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Kubelet Read-Only Port 10255 Across All Node Configurations (CIS 4.2.4) (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.readOnlyPort according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_anonymous_auth_disabled_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubelet Anonymous Authentication Disabled (authentication.anonymous.enabled = false) (Tier-3 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 5.2.1, NIST SP 800-190, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.authentication.anonymous.enabled according to CIS K8s 5.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

title: Enforce Kubelet Webhook Authorization (authorization.mode = Webhook) (Tier-3 • Profile K)
description: Implements in-depth Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) and pod-level defense for Node within Zero Trust Service Mesh & Cilium eBPF L7 Enforcement. Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS K8s 4.2.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group control(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Control Plane & RBAC Authority]
    group mesh(logos:k8s-ebpf)[mTLS eBPF Datapath Mesh]
    group storage(logos:k8s-pvc)[Persistent Storage & Sealed Secrets]

    service api(logos:k8s-apiserver)[Kube-APIServer] in control
    service role(logos:k8s-role)[Least-Privilege Role] in control
    service sa(logos:k8s-serviceaccount)[Token-Projected SA] in control

    service cilium(logos:k8s-ebpf)[Cilium L7 HTTP Filter] in mesh
    service workload(logos:k8s-node)[Kubelet & Node Host Security (CIS Benchmark)] in mesh
    service netpol(logos:k8s-networkpolicy)[Egress FQDN Whitelist] in mesh

    service sec(logos:k8s-secret)[KMS Envelope Secret] in storage
    service pvc(logos:k8s-pvc)[ReadWriteOnce CSI Volume] in storage
    service pdb(logos:k8s-pdb)[PodDisruptionBudget] in storage

    api:R --> L:role
    role:B --> T:sa
    sa:B --> T:cilium
    cilium:R --> L:workload
    workload:R --> L:netpol
    workload:B --> T:sec
    sec:R --> L:pvc
    pvc:R --> L:pdb

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_authorization_webhook_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kubelet Webhook Authorization (authorization.mode = Webhook) (Tier-3 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 4.2.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AC-6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.authorization.mode according to CIS K8s 4.2.4", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kernel_sysctl_hardening_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Kernel Sysctl Hardening and Protected Symlinks on Kubernetes Worker Nodes (Tier-3 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS K8s 1.2.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, MITRE ATT&CK Containers T1611, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.sysctl
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define sysctl.fs.protected_symlinks according to CIS K8s 1.2.1", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-3"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-3"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "reliability"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-3)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"

Enforces explicit pod securityContext directives, least-privilege RBAC, eBPF microsegmentation, and CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance. Fully mapped to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.

    rb:B --> T:workload

opa_policy:
package kubernetes.admission.k8s_node.k8s_node_node_kubelet_readonly_port_disabled_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Kubelet Read-Only Port 10255 Across All Node Configurations (CIS 4.2.4) (Tier-4 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8, NSA/CISA Kubernetes Hardening Guide, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 6.4, SOC 2 CC6.6
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Node"
  obj := input.request.object
  not obj.kubeletConfig
  msg := sprintf("Workload %v fails KSPM guardrail: must define kubeletConfig.readOnlyPort according to CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8", [obj.metadata.name])
}
terraform:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: "k8s-node-hardened-4"
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: "k8s-node"
    security.kspm.io/tier: "tier-4"
    security.kspm.io/pillar: "security"
    compliance.kspm.io/benchmark: "cis-k8s-v1.8"
spec:
  # Pod-level security hardening & admission guardrails (Tier-4)
  template:
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest@sha256:verified"
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
